info.name: Care Companion - Stateless Chat
info.description: POST /api/chat/message is stateless: the patient record, the conversation so far and the message all arrive in the body. No X-Tenant header, no auth, nothing stored.

item.name: 0. Health check - is the FAQ ingested?

request.description: Run this first. If it 502s, the FAQ is not ingested and every chat message will 502 too. Fix with: python manage.py ingest_faq "../FAQ_Handbook_Care_Companion_Enrollment Document.docx"

body.raw:
{
  "conv_id": "{{convId}}",

  "firstName": "Jane",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "fullName": "Jane Doe",
  "dob": "1958-04-12",
  "gender": "Female",
  "ehrId": "EHR-8842",
  "mobilePhone": "(312) 555-0134",
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "practiceName": "Lakeview Family Medicine",
  "practice_phone": "(312) 555-0100",
  "providerName": "Dr. Alan Reyes",
  "careManager": "Maria Lopez",
  "appointmentDate": "2026-08-01",
  "dataAge": "1 month",

  "text": "what does this cost me?"
}

request.description: Expect 200, tag "", status "active". The reply should quote the FAQ on coverage and end with one question.

item.name: 2. Turn two - ready to enroll (expects CONSENT)

body.raw:
{
  "conv_id": "{{convId}}",

  "fullName": "Jane Doe",
  "practiceName": "Lakeview Family Medicine",
  "practice_phone": "(312) 555-0100",
  "providerName": "Dr. Alan Reyes",
  "careManager": "Maria Lopez",
  "dataAge": "1 month",

  "text": "yes, I am ready to sign up",

  "history": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "what does this cost me?" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "Covered by Medicare and most commercial insurance. Shall I go through what you would be agreeing to?" }
  ]
}

request.description: Expect tag "CONSENT" and the seven reviewed points verbatim, with the name and provider filled in. The model's own wording is discarded.

item.name: 3. Turn three - yes to all seven (expects ENROLLED)

request.description: Expect status "enrolled". Without the seven points in history the model will not enroll - that is the rule working.

body.raw:
{
  "conv_id": "{{convId}}",

  "fullName": "Jane Doe",
  "practiceName": "Lakeview Family Medicine",
  "practice_phone": "(312) 555-0100",
  "providerName": "Dr. Alan Reyes",
  "dataAge": "1 month",

  "text": "I have had chest pain since this morning"
}

request.description: Expect tag "EMERGENCY" and alert true. Nothing pages a human any more - your caller must act on alert:true itself.

item.name: 5. Opt out (no OpenAI call at all)

request.description: Expect tag "OPTOUT", status "optedout". Short circuits before the model, so it is instant and free.

item.name: 6. Minimum payload - only the two required fields

request.description: Expect 200. Provider and practice fall back to "your care team" and the record reads "(No patient record was sent.)".
Expect 400 with result.text = ["This field is required."].
